name: Shrimp Couscous with Tomatoes, Zucchini & Feta

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, bring broth to a boil over high heat. Remove from heat, add couscous, and stir. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes then fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
532 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.36 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches fresh dill
3 medium zucchini squash
3 yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Halve tomatoes. Cut peppers into quarters, remove seeds and membranes and slice into strips. Medium dice the zucchini into ½-inch cubes. Transfer cut veggies into a medium bowl.
Preheat the large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the shrimp and garlic to the pot; cook until shrimp are opaque, 1-2 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Return pot to the heat, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add peppers, zucchini, tomato, and oregano to the skillet, stirring occasionally until vegetables soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp virgin coconut oil
1 ½ tsp oregano

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves from stalk; discard stalk and mince leaves.
Once veggies are soft add broth, scraping up any browned bits, and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated, 6-7 minutes.
Add dill to the skillet, along with the shrimp and any accumulated juices; allow to cook for 1 minute more.
To serve, divide couscous between plates and top with the shrimp, veggies, and crumbled feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
